purpose: Diagnose train/val_select only before defining another training experiment; no training, model selection, recalibration or CFE/test benchmark.

operating_point.scope: Historical training selection point, applied identically to both checkpoints for diagnosis; not their deployment calibration.

protocol.q30_order: historical balanced 300 first, then remaining validation records in manifest order; identifies the historical slice explicitly
protocol.scope: Every validation image measured under both conditions; historical Q30 slice also reported separately. No guarantee of bitwise historical replay across different GPUs or batch sizes.

scientific_limits: val_select was already used to select P0; this is diagnostic data, not a fresh holdout.
Generator names and labels come from the manifest; semantic correctness needs image review.
No threshold estimated on validation is exported for deployment.
No new training arm is selected until per-image validation diagnosis is available.
